repository.name: example-orders-service
repository.workload: Unknown — the example review deliberately proceeds without one

annotation.notes: A test fixture, not a corpus entry. It exists so CI can prove the scorer runs end to end against the committed example review; real annotations live in benchmark/ground-truth/. The severity here matches the example exactly, so any drift between the schema, the example, and the scorer shows up as a failing metric rather than as silence.

expected.mechanism: The order listing issues one datastore query per order rather than one query for all of them, so query count grows linearly with rows returned.

acceptable.mechanism: A formatting helper is rebuilt on every call rather than reused. Real, but small next to the datastore work on the same path — a review may report it or discard it.

forbidden.why_not: Adding an index on the status column would add write cost with no read benefit: no query in the reviewed code filters on that column. Recommending it is the kind of suggestion that looks productive and is not.
